instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, three friends are playfully dancing. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) steps forward in black shorts and grey sneakers, looking down at the feet of the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) in the center. The woman in the beige hoodie (R1) steps forward in grey leggings and pink sneakers, looking down with a focused smile. On the right, the woman in the grey hijab (R3) steps forward in a pink jacket, white pants, and pink sneakers, also looking down at her feet. Soft, natural daylight with a warm tone highlights their expressions, while the right edge of the frame is softly blurred.
